changelog:
Initial release: End-to-end installer and environment checker for Alibaba Cloud Agent Toolkit.

- Guides users step-by-step to check and install all prerequisites (uv, Alibaba Cloud CLI, CLI plugins).
- Enforces a strict safety policy: asks for user confirmation on any install or cloud write action; never executes pipe-to-shell commands automatically.
- Checks CLI authentication (AK or OAuth), provides clear user instructions for OAuth setup.
- Verifies and sets up MCP Server Core resource, with explicit user approval for cloud changes.
- Handles bearer token exchange checks.
- Installs Alibaba Cloud Agent Toolkit via openplugin, only after all prerequisites pass.
- Tracks all CLI operations with a unique user-agent for observability.
